Keep writes an inline data image with its payload

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert, ConversionOptions, InlineDataMedia

def main() -> None:
    html = '<p>Before <img src="data:image/png;base64,AAAA" alt="icon"> after</p>'
    options = ConversionOptions(inline_data_media=InlineDataMedia("Keep"))
    result = convert(html, options)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
